levels.title: Runtime Source Modules
levels.description: Depth 5: twelve responsibility-owned source modules and every resolved cross-module dependency.

nodes.title: Model Contract
nodes.summary: Provide the unique design vocabulary consumed by every downstream capability.

inspector.principle: Own BlockDesignDocument, schema evolution, semantic validation, and stateless graph queries.
inspector.purpose: Provide the unique design vocabulary consumed by every downstream capability.
inspector.boundary: No React, workspace, history, layout, routing, or file-download ownership.
inspector.failure: Reject invalid structure at a field path and return semantic issues without mutating input.

nodes.title: Canonical File I/O
nodes.summary: Load URL or local files and serialize stable save/download output.

inspector.principle: Own conversion between external JSON and a validated canonical document.
inspector.purpose: Load URL or local files and serialize stable save/download output.
inspector.boundary: Does not interpret module business meaning or retain an installed document.
inspector.failure: Return explicit load errors and preserve the previously installed design.

nodes.title: Atomic Editor
nodes.summary: Turn validated user intent into one complete document transition and one undo boundary.

inspector.principle: Own atomic DesignOperation transforms, history, dirty state, and portable fragments.
inspector.purpose: Turn validated user intent into one complete document transition and one undo boundary.
inspector.boundary: Does not render, route, choose workspace focus, or perform external file transport.
inspector.failure: Any failed precondition leaves the original document and history unchanged.

nodes.title: Layout Projection
nodes.summary: Provide deterministic design-coordinate geometry without storing UI gestures.

inspector.principle: Derive compound node geometry, placement signatures, guides, arrangement, and resize math.
inspector.purpose: Provide deterministic design-coordinate geometry without storing UI gestures.
inspector.boundary: Cannot mutate BlockDesignDocument or depend on Studio and React components.
inspector.failure: Invalid geometry or placement failures surface to the Studio without fallback facts.

nodes.title: Routing Engine
nodes.summary: Produce readable obstacle-aware routes and disposable connection previews.

inspector.principle: Own scene adaptation, deterministic orthogonal solving, route editing, and independent verification.
inspector.purpose: Produce readable obstacle-aware routes and disposable connection previews.
inspector.boundary: Does not move modules, own gestures, or write automatic routes into JSON.
inspector.failure: Return an explicit unresolved result instead of using a second hidden router.

nodes.title: Command & Selection
nodes.summary: Let menus, keyboard, Canvas, Inspector, and Studio speak one interaction protocol.

inspector.principle: Own the leaf contracts for command availability and canonical workspace selection.
inspector.purpose: Let menus, keyboard, Canvas, Inspector, and Studio speak one interaction protocol.
inspector.boundary: Does not render UI, execute editor mutations, or own viewport navigation.
inspector.failure: Unavailable commands carry one visible reason; invalid selections resolve without hidden cursors.

nodes.title: Workbench Components
nodes.summary: Project current commands, selection, document, and issues into discoverable controls.

inspector.principle: Own accessible menus, dialogs, docks, navigation trees, Inspector, and review surfaces.
inspector.purpose: Project current commands, selection, document, and issues into discoverable controls.
inspector.boundary: Does not duplicate eligibility, selection, schema, editing, or route-solving rules.
inspector.failure: Preserve focus and drafts, expose disabled reasons, and send rejected actions back visibly.

nodes.title: Studio Orchestrator
nodes.summary: Coordinate selection, draft protection, commands, layout, routing, dialogs, and feedback.

inspector.principle: Compose public module contracts into the complete editing, review, and file workflow.
inspector.purpose: Coordinate selection, draft protection, commands, layout, routing, dialogs, and feedback.
inspector.boundary: Does not redefine any owned model, editor, file, geometry, protocol, or component rule.
inspector.failure: Reject unsafe transitions visibly and keep document, history, selection, and focus recoverable.

nodes.title: Visual Tokens
nodes.summary: Keep surfaces, typography, spacing, z-order, focus, and motion visually coherent.

inspector.principle: Own shared visual constants and semantic component presentation.
inspector.purpose: Keep surfaces, typography, spacing, z-order, focus, and motion visually coherent.
inspector.boundary: Contains no document, command, selection, layout, or routing semantics.
inspector.failure: Unsupported states remain visible through semantic classes instead of hidden inline overrides.

nodes.title: Application Assembly
nodes.summary: Provide the browser application's minimal product entry contract.

inspector.principle: Choose the initial design source and assemble the standalone Studio.
inspector.purpose: Provide the browser application's minimal product entry contract.
inspector.boundary: Does not own design content, commands, loading rules, or editor state.
inspector.failure: Delegates load failures to the Studio while retaining the current installed document.

nodes.title: Browser Bootstrap
nodes.summary: Bridge the HTML host to the typed application assembly.

inspector.principle: Mount one React root and install the application-wide visual stylesheet.
inspector.purpose: Bridge the HTML host to the typed application assembly.
inspector.boundary: Contains no product workflow, document, or geometry decisions.
inspector.failure: A missing host root fails immediately instead of mounting a partial Studio.
